name: Via Lugdunum, Geneva to Lyon
description_md:
The Via Lugdunum spans 155.3 km from Geneva to Lyon as a waymarked hiking route in France. This hard international network trail features 228 m of ascent and 263 m of descent.

The walking time is about 5.8 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. The path passes Pérouges within 200 m and Lyon within 1900 m.
